_comment: Chapter 2 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F09, a rescue: the cartographer goes home (hints about who is still held).

text.zh_TW: 製圖師縮在角落畫地圖。「噓，我在畫逃生路線……啊，里歐！你就是逃生路線！」
text.en: The cartographer huddles in a corner, drawing a map. "Shh, I'm drawing an escape route... oh, Leo! YOU are the escape route!"

text.zh_TW: 製圖師：「回村後來問我，我把看到被抓的人都畫在地圖上。」
text.en: Cartographer: "Ask me back in the village. I'll mark everyone I saw them take on my map."
